name: killer-sudoku
description: A minimalist Killer Sudoku. Static site plus a small leaderboard, streak, sync and duels API (Pages Functions + D1, Durable Objects for duels).

scripts.db:local: npx --yes wrangler d1 execute cagey-leaderboard --local --file migrations/0001_scores.sql && npx --yes wrangler d1 execute cagey-leaderboard --local --file migrations/0002_daily.sql && npx --yes wrangler d1 execute cagey-leaderboard --local --file migrations/0003_sync.sql && npx --yes wrangler d1 execute cagey-leaderboard --local --file migrations/0004_passkeys.sql && npx --yes wrangler d1 execute cagey-leaderboard --local --file migrations/0005_replays.sql
scripts.deploy: npx --yes wrangler pages deploy public --project-name cagey
